messages:
jamie: Quick heads-up — planning rollforward tonight 23:00 UTC for runtime v3.2.1 + SDK v2.9. before we flip the switch we need one last interop pass across the model binding matrix.

dahlia: noted. I can run the binding matrix smoke tests at 22:00 UTC. what baseline should I compare to?

jamie: baseline = current pinned runtime 3.1.9 + sdk 2.8. use the stable testset (longseq + convo_flow). focus on llama3q and mpt-7b-quant. do a correctness diff + p95 latency.

ben: @dahlia I can run a small A/B throughput sweep on dedicated pool afterwards (22:30). watch for KV-cache misses.

maria: minor note — release notes will include: runtime kernel fixes for rotary embeddings, SDK public header rename, and new binding tolerance for quantized models. tagging security for the KMS note.

deploybot: Automessage: pinlist staged for review — runtime:3.2.1, sdk:2.9, models:[llama3q-1.0,q-mpt7b-v0.3]. Approvals: infra_needed.

jamie: @deploybot good. But we need to avoid a global unpin if any binding fails. plan is staggered rollforward by cohort: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 40m windows with health gates. backstop = automatic revert to runtime 3.1.9 if error rate > 1.2% for 5m.

ben: rolling by cohort sounds good. add a manual hold flag for nightshift. we should also pre-warm model-proxy for quant variants to reduce cold-kv misses.

dahlia: running tests now. quick snippet for the binding test config I'm using:```json
{
  "runtime": "3.2.1-canary",
  "sdk": "2.9-rc",
  "models": ["llama3q-1.0-q8", "mpt-7b-quant-v0.3"],
  "tests": ["longseq_smoke", "convo_flow_smoke"],
  "metrics": ["p95_latency","token_error_rate","kv_cache_hit"]
}
```

sre-oncall: @dahlia ping me if p95 spikes > 2x baseline. I'll open an incident stub and keep watchers.

maria: docs/console release note draft in PR #4125, adding the rollback procedure and canary gating thresholds.

dahlia: first pass done — correctness diffs trivial for llama3q, mpt shows a small rerank delta on longseq (0.9% drift) but under our 1% threshold, kv_cache_hit dropped 3% on quant models (p95 up 18ms). uploading artifacts to /tmp/interop-run-1767539999.tar.gz

jamie: thanks. @ben please run throughput sweep; if you see sustained p95 > baseline+50ms or kv drop >5% then hold. otherwise proceed with cohort rollout at 23:00.

ben: starting throughput sweep (22:32). will post summary in 10m.

deploybot: Reminder: release window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Auto-rollback configured. Notify #incidents if rollback triggers. :bell:

ben: sweep done — throughput within 3% of baseline, p95 delta +22ms on quant-llama3q under heavy load, kv_cache_hit steady vs canary after pre-warm. recommending proceed but keep cohort window at 20m instead of 40m to reduce blast radius.

jamie: decision: proceed with staggered rollout at 23:00 UTC with 20m cohorts. manual watch for first cohort; @sre-oncall standby. Release notes and PRs linked in the deploy ticket. If deploybot flags revert, we cut to pinned runtime 3.1.9 and open rollback postmortem. :thumbsup:

maria: tagging compliance and creating audit event (ticket #A-7893).

sre-oncall: Standby active. will escalate at first anomalous spike.

jamie: thanks everyone. will post post-deploy telemetry after midnight and close the loop.
